title: Sequential Mirror program over one physical block
hypothesis: For an aligned three-step non-commutative linear program, one physical 3x3 block with a distinct three-angle Givens-conjugation View at each step will reach mean held-out RMSE <= 0.05, use at least 25% fewer actual bytes than three independent blocks, and preserve order sensitivity (reversing View order raises RMSE at least 2x); the directly parameterized native Givens conditioner tests attribution.
physical_object: one shared 3x3 linear transformation matrix reused at three sequential steps
mirror_coordinate: one 3-angle Euler/Givens rotation coordinate per step, applied as R_j W R_j^T
logical_multiplicity: three ordered step-specific transformations from one physical block
controls: one ordinary tied linear block repeated three times
three independent step-specific linear blocks (Routing Networks/multiple-block upper control)
one block with per-step rank-1 matrix residuals
one shared block with direct native three-angle Givens conjugation per step (exact parameterization alias control)
same trained Mirror model evaluated with step-code order reversed

task.type: synthetic 3D linear regression of an ordered composition of three non-commuting Givens-conjugated matrices
task.teacher: M2 @ M1 @ M0 where M_j = R_j W R_j^T, W and each R_j are seeded; Gaussian input and sigma=0.01 output noise
task.ordered_probe: evaluate the same learned step views in reversed composition order; no tuning from this result

development.selection_metric: mean held-out RMSE across the same 512 examples per seed

paid_objects: step Mirror angles or rank-1 residuals
format, shape, dtype and depth metadata

compute.compute_proxy_definition: assume deterministic R_j W R_j^T step matrices are reconstructed once when loading inference state; report cold-start reconstruction MACs separately and report inference operations/example amortized across the 512 held-out queries (3 vector-matrix applications plus reconstruction MACs divided by 512)

gates.PROMISING: Both development seeds: Mirror RMSE <= 0.05; actual payload <= 0.75x independent-three-block payload; ordered-code reversal RMSE >= 2x correct-order RMSE; and active ops/example <= 2x independent stack. Native Givens must not exactly match Mirror output and payload hash.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses any PROMISING gate, Mirror exactly matches the native Givens map/payload, or the independent stack has lower RMSE at no greater actual bytes on both seeds.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: The independent stack has RMSE >0.05 on either seed, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Mechanism screen on a teacher generated from the same Givens-conjugation family; not natural language or general routing-network evidence.
The direct native Givens conditioner is intentionally an exact functional-form control.
Fixed-update learning efficiency is not a capacity claim; no near-convergence or broad byte frontier is claimed.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless every frozen PROMISING gate passes.
